title: Khanom Krok with Tofu and Unique Thai Filling
description: A creative twist on traditional Khanom Krok, filled with a unique Thai-inspired tofu mixture, crispy snappy vegetables, and served with a side of sweet chutney.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
Prepare the Unique Thai Filling by mixing together tofu, snappy, and a pinch of salt.
Prepare the Khanom Krok Batter by mixing together flour, water, and a pinch of salt.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the batter into the hot oil and fry until golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the Khanom Krok and drain on paper towels.
Stuff each Khanom Krok with a tablespoon of the Unique Thai Filling.
Serve hot with a side of sweet chutney made by mixing together brown sugar, fish sauce, and lime juice.
